tool_args.rationale: The paid data show positive response at short horizons and increasingly negative response at long horizons, matching the dual-horizon endogenous reversal. Fit the four law parameters numerically; the prior execution error resulted from predicting without retrieving fitted parameters, so predict now reads the fitted parameter vector from the row.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Already acquired; reversal between short and long horizons is observed.
Its eight-row requirement applies to the coupled memory ODE, whereas this dataset matches the supplied dual-horizon reversal mechanism.

considered_alternatives.option: Static gain, harmonic, and linear-drift models
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: They do not naturally explain the sign change with horizon as directly as the observed dual-horizon adaptation law.
